title: Earth: shape, size and the graticule
quote: 1° of latitude ≈ 111 km everywhere; 1° of longitude shrinks to zero at the poles

boxes.title: Shape
items: ==**Geoid** / oblate spheroid==: bulges at **equator**, flat at **poles**
**Aristotle**: first stated source for spherical Earth
Weight: **minimum at equator**, maximum at poles (centrifugal force max at equator)
Evidence: ship's mast seen first; circular shadow in **lunar eclipse**; circumnavigation
Nearest surface point to centre: **Arctic Ocean floor near North Pole**
Ice melt → equator bulges, rotation slows (~**1.33 ms per century**)

boxes.title: Graticule facts
items: Parallels at 1°: ==**179**== (poles are points; BPSC 2023); meridians **360**
**Great circle**: Equator (only parallel) + opposite meridian pairs
1° long: **111 km** at equator → ~55.5 km at 60° → 0 at poles
